cond_0001.intro: The Solutions Analyst proactively and holistically leads and partners with various business teams to guide the development and management of a portfolio of solutions. This individual is accountable to align Information and Technology teams to the concepts and understanding of the business goals, objectives and business outcomes, business capabilities, value-streams, and business processes and their importance in the overall enterprise application landscape. The Solution Analyst provides the necessary leadership, analysis and design tasks related to support the development of technology solutions to ensure that solutions meet business needs and align with architectural governance and standards. They create deliverables for managing the organization's portfolio of ""to be"" and ""as is"" solutions — including systems (applications, processes, information and technology), shared infrastructure services, and shared application services and components to enable and drive targeted business outcomes.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Interpret Business Needs: Translate retail business requirements into technical solutions, align resources, and understand business drivers to drive targeted outcomes.
Assess Technology: Monitor solution portfolio, identify deficiencies, research emerging tech trends, and recommend improvements.
Apply Technology: Serve as a liaison between business and IT, lead solution implementation, develop roadmaps, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture.
System Administration: Act as a system administrator for retail systems, ensuring their smooth operation, maintenance, and optimization to support business functions effectively.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information systems, project management, or general business management (or a related field); alternatively, equivalent progressive IT experience.
Minimum of 3-4 years of experience in IT solution development disciplines with heavy focus on automation and data-driven decisions.
Skilled in leading major workstreams or enhancements as part of a large project or proven experience leading smaller projects.
Experience supporting a multi-unit retail organization with ability to translate retail business challenges into IT solutions.
Experience with project or task management tools (i.e., Smartsheet, Azure DevOps/Boards, JIRA, Microsoft Project, etc.), creative solution tools (i.e., Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Power Apps, PowerShell scripting, Power BI, Tableau); functional design tools (i.e., Visio or similar flowcharting tools, UML diagrams, etc.).
Strong communication skills (written and verbal).
Proficient in creating architecture blueprints, strategies, and roadmaps.
Understanding of product management, agile principles and development methodologies and capability of supporting agile teams by providing advice and guidance on opportunities, impact, and risks, taking account of technical and architectural debt.
Understanding of IT standards, controls, and application development methodologies.
Ability to collaborate with developers in an outsourced environment.
Ability to influence and guide stakeholders in decision-making, leading through indirect management.
Translating business requirements into solution requirements.
Creative and analytical problem-solving skills.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in point-of-sale (POS), merchandising, pricing, and planning.
Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system and/or ERP system implementation experience; [Product name masked] experience.
Point-of-Sale (POS) system experience, preferably NCR.
Exposure to multiple, diverse technologies, platforms, and processing environments.
Ability to research and present technology trends and their application to business models.
Ability to prioritize and handle competing priorities.
Experience in delivering presentations to executives and technical audiences.
Familiarity with infrastructure and network architecture.
Organizational skills to navigate politics and competing agendas.
Effective communication of ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Balancing long-term and short-term goals.
Estimating the financial impact of solution alternatives.
Quick comprehension of new technologies' functions and capabilities.

cond_0104.intro: The Solutions Analyst proactively and holistically leads and partners with various business teams to guide the development and management of a portfolio of solutions. This individual is accountable to align Information and Technology teams to the concepts and understanding of the business goals, objectives and business outcomes, business capabilities, value-streams, and business processes and their importance in the overall enterprise application landscape. The Solution Analyst provides the necessary leadership, analysis and design tasks related to support the development of technology solutions to ensure that solutions meet business needs and align with architectural governance and standards. They create deliverables for managing the organization's portfolio of ""to be"" and ""as is"" solutions — including systems (applications, processes, information and technology), shared infrastructure services, and shared application services and components to enable and drive targeted business outcomes. cond_0152.intro: We are looking for a Retail Business System Analyst to join our team. The Solutions Analyst owns and leads partnerships with various business teams to guide the development and management of a portfolio of solutions. This individual is accountable for aligning Information and Technology teams to business goals, objectives, outcomes, capabilities, value-streams, and processes within the overall enterprise application landscape. The Solutions Analyst delivers the leadership, analysis, and design work needed to develop technology solutions that meet business needs and align with architectural governance and standards. They produce deliverables for managing the organization's portfolio of current and future solutions — including systems, shared infrastructure services, and shared application services and components — to drive targeted business outcomes.

Interpret Business Needs: Translate retail business requirements into technical solutions, direct resource alignment, and determine business drivers to achieve targeted outcomes.
Assess Technology: Own the solution portfolio, identify deficiencies, research emerging tech trends, and drive recommended improvements.
Apply Technology: Lead the liaison function between business and IT, execute solution implementation, develop roadmaps, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture.
System Administration: Take ownership of system administration for retail systems, ensuring their smooth operation, maintenance, and optimization to support business functions effectively.
cond_0152.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information systems, project management, or general business management (or a related field); alternatively, equivalent progressive IT experience.
Minimum of 3–4 years of experience in IT solution development disciplines with heavy focus on automation and data-driven decisions.
Skilled in leading major workstreams or enhancements as part of a large project, or proven experience leading smaller projects.
Experience supporting a multi-unit retail organization with ability to translate retail business challenges into IT solutions.
Experience with project or task management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Azure DevOps/Boards, JIRA, Microsoft Project) and creative solution tools (e.g., Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Power Apps, PowerShell scripting, Power BI, Tableau).
Exposure to multiple, diverse technologies, platforms, and processing environments.
Strong communication skills (written and verbal).
Ability to prioritize and manage competing priorities with urgency.
Proficient in creating architecture blueprints, strategies, and roadmaps.
Understanding of product management, agile principles, and development methodologies, with ability to support agile teams by providing advice on opportunities, impact, and risks, accounting for technical and architectural debt.
Understanding of IT standards, controls, and application development methodologies.
Ability to collaborate with developers in an outsourced environment.
Ability to influence and guide stakeholders in decision-making through indirect management.
Ability to translate business requirements into solution requirements.
Creative and analytical problem-solving skills.
Quick comprehension of new technologies' functions and capabilities.

Experience in point-of-sale (POS), merchandising, pricing, and planning.
Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system and/or ERP system implementation experience; [Product name masked] experience strongly preferred.
Point-of-Sale (POS) system experience, preferably NCR.
Functional design tools experience (e.g., Visio or similar flowcharting tools, UML diagrams).
Ability to research and present technology trends and their application to business models.
Experience delivering presentations to executives and technical audiences.
Familiarity with infrastructure and network architecture.
Organizational skills to navigate competing agendas.
Effective communication of ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.

cond_0220.intro: The Solutions Analyst proactively and holistically leads and partners with various business teams to guide the development and management of a portfolio of solutions. Assess Technology: Monitor solution portfolio, identify deficiencies, research emerging tech trends, and recommend improvements.

System Administration: Act as a system administrator for retail systems, ensuring their smooth operation, maintenance, and optimization to support business functions effectively.

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information systems, project management, or general business management (or a related field); alternatively, equivalent progressive IT experience.

Skilled in leading major workstreams or enhancements as part of a large project or proven experience leading smaller projects.
Experience supporting a multi-unit retail organization with ability to translate retail business challenges into IT solutions.
Experience with project or task management tools (i.e., Smartsheet, Azure DevOps/Boards, JIRA, Microsoft Project, etc.), creative solution tools (i.e., Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Power Apps, PowerShell scripting, Power BI, Tableau); functional design tools (i.e., Visio or similar flowcharting tools, UML diagrams, etc.).

Understanding of product management, agile principles and development methodologies and capability of supporting agile teams by providing advice and guidance on opportunities, impact, and risks, taking account of technical and architectural debt.
Understanding of IT standards, controls, and application development methodologies.
Ability to collaborate with developers in an outsourced environment.
Ability to influence and guide stakeholders in decision-making, leading through indirect management.

This individual is accountable for aligning Information and Technology teams to business goals, objectives, outcomes, capabilities, value-streams, and processes within the overall enterprise application landscape. The Solutions Analyst delivers the leadership, analysis, and design work needed to develop technology solutions that meet business needs and align with architectural governance and standards. They produce deliverables for managing the organization's portfolio of current and future solutions — including systems, shared infrastructure services, and shared application services and components — to drive targeted business outcomes.
cond_0242.responsibilities:
Interpret Business Needs: Translate retail business requirements into technical solutions, direct resource alignment, and determine business drivers to achieve targeted outcomes.
Assess Technology: Own the solution portfolio, identify deficiencies, research emerging tech trends, and drive recommended improvements.
Apply Technology: Lead the liaison function between business and IT, execute solution implementation, develop roadmaps, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture.
System Administration: Take ownership of system administration for retail systems, ensuring their smooth operation, maintenance, and optimization to support business functions effectively.
cond_0242.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information systems, project management, or general business management (or a related field); alternatively, equivalent progressive IT experience.
Minimum of 3–4 years of experience in IT solution development disciplines with heavy focus on automation and data-driven decisions.
Skilled in leading major workstreams or enhancements as part of a large project, or proven experience leading smaller projects.
Experience supporting a multi-unit retail organization with ability to translate retail business challenges into IT solutions.
Experience with project or task management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Azure DevOps/Boards, JIRA, Microsoft Project) and creative solution tools (e.g., Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Power Apps, PowerShell scripting, Power BI, Tableau).
Exposure to multiple, diverse technologies, platforms, and processing environments.
Strong communication skills (written and verbal).
Ability to prioritize and manage competing priorities with urgency.
Proficient in creating architecture blueprints, strategies, and roadmaps.
Understanding of product management, agile principles, and development methodologies, with ability to support agile teams by providing advice on opportunities, impact, and risks, accounting for technical and architectural debt.
Understanding of IT standards, controls, and application development methodologies.
Ability to collaborate with developers in an outsourced environment.
Ability to influence and guide stakeholders in decision-making through indirect management.
Ability to translate business requirements into solution requirements.
Creative and analytical problem-solving skills.
Quick comprehension of new technologies' functions and capabilities.

Experience in point-of-sale (POS), merchandising, pricing, and planning.
Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system and/or ERP system implementation experience; [Product name masked] experience strongly preferred.
Point-of-Sale (POS) system experience, preferably NCR.
Functional design tools experience (e.g., Visio or similar flowcharting tools, UML diagrams).

Experience delivering presentations to executives and technical audiences.
Familiarity with infrastructure and network architecture.
Organizational skills to navigate competing agendas.
Effective communication of ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.

In this role, you will work alongside business and IT teams to help shape and manage a portfolio of technology solutions. You will support alignment between technical teams and business goals, and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure solutions meet business needs and fit within established architectural standards. Together with your colleagues, you will help maintain and evolve the organization's current and future solution landscape — including applications, processes, shared infrastructure, and application services — to support targeted business outcomes.
cond_0297.responsibilities:
Interpret Business Needs: Work with retail business stakeholders to understand requirements, help translate them into technical solutions, and coordinate with teams to align resources toward shared outcomes.
Assess Technology: Together with relevant teams, monitor the solution portfolio, identify gaps, research emerging technology trends, and share recommendations for improvement.
Apply Technology: Serve as a liaison between business and IT, coordinate solution implementation, contribute to roadmap development, and help ensure alignment with enterprise architecture.
System Administration: Work alongside operations and IT teams to support retail systems, helping ensure smooth operation, maintenance, and optimization to meet business needs.
cond_0297.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information systems, project management, or general business management (or a related field); or equivalent progressive IT experience.
Minimum of 3–4 years of experience in IT solution development with a heavy focus on automation and data-driven decisions.
Experience supporting a multi-unit retail organization with ability to translate retail business challenges into IT solutions.
Experience with project or task management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Azure DevOps/Boards, JIRA, Microsoft Project) and creative solution tools (e.g., Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Power Apps, PowerShell scripting, Power BI, Tableau).
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to present to executive and technical audiences.
Proficient in creating architecture blueprints, strategies, and roadmaps.
Understanding of product management, agile principles, and development methodologies.
Understanding of IT standards, controls, and application development methodologies.
Ability to collaborate with developers in an outsourced environment.
Ability to influence and guide stakeholders in decision-making through indirect management.
Analytical and creative problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate business requirements into solution requirements.
Preferred Requirements
Experience leading major workstreams or enhancements within a large project, or proven experience leading smaller projects.
Experience in point-of-sale (POS), merchandising, pricing, and planning.
ERP system experience and/or ERP implementation experience; [Product name masked] experience a plus.
Point-of-sale (POS) system experience, preferably NCR.
Exposure to multiple, diverse technologies, platforms, and processing environments.
Functional design tools experience (e.g., Visio or similar flowcharting tools, UML diagrams).
Familiarity with infrastructure and network architecture.
Ability to research and present technology trends and their application to business models.
Ability to estimate the financial impact of solution alternatives.
Organizational skills to navigate competing priorities and stakeholder agendas.
Ability to balance long-term and short-term goals.
Quick comprehension of new technologies' functions and capabilities.
